name: Aurellion diamond uninitialized initialize takeover
summary: The owner's diamondCut registered the SafeOwnable facet's initialize(address) selector without invoking any initializer, leaving the OpenZeppelin guard slot at zero on a diamond whose ownership had never written it. The attacker called initialize() to seize ownership, cut in a malicious facet exposing pullERC20, and swept outstanding user USDC approvals via transferFrom.
notes: Owner diamondCut registered the SafeOwnable facet's initialize selector with an empty init call, writing the facet address into the diamond's selector-routing storage. The guard slot stayed zero, leaving initialize() open to any caller from this block.

Exact attacker receipts in the single anchor transaction: 450999.723188 USDC from 0x2e933518068b1cfc9746d94762ef2eddd39c6048, 3.0 USDC from 0xa90714a15d6e5c0eb3096462de8dc4b22e01589a, and 1.281433 USDC from 0xeced2d37e5edcfc67ffb74c655416f893d20793e via pullERC20 transferFrom, plus 5438.532001 USDC of diamond-held balance, all forwarded to the attacker EOA. No attacker-supplied campaign inputs besides gas.
